findings.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Delayed Dubbo provider completion lacks installed-agent integration coverage across supported completion API shapes.
1 open issue - [Add installed-agent tests for delayed Dubbo provider span completion](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20675#discussion_r4308245509) · New
Review effort: Balanced

[Testing] The delayed-provider cases in `TracingFilterTest` invoke the library filter with a hand-built `AsyncRpcResult`. The installed-agent suite inherits `AbstractDubboTest`, whose `$invokeAsync` calls the synchronous `HelloServiceImpl.hello`, so it does not exercise completion after the provider returns. Add shared delayed-provider success and failure tests with the installed agent, using supported versions that exercise both `whenCompleteWithContext` and `getResultFuture`. Assert that the server span stays open until completion, ends once, and records the terminal failure status and preview `error.type`. This covers the new lifecycle through Dubbo's actual provider pipeline and injected helpers.

Adds bounded `error.type` to new and duplicate RPC telemetry for terminal failures while preserving legacy output.

- **gRPC:** Classify terminal status codes by client/server role; omit server cancellations.
- **Thrift:** Classify serialized failures as `_OTHER` when no throwable survives, retaining more-specific classifications otherwise.
- **Metrics:** Include `error.type` in advice for new RPC duration histograms only.
- **Dubbo:** End provider spans on asynchronous completion across supported 2.7 API shapes.
metadata.title: Capture terminal error.type for new RPC telemetry
